mentions.note: actor; joined Belgrave in October 1968; training for the film 'The Games'
actor who played Harry Hayes in "The Games"; joined the Bels while preparing for the part and was pictured training on Wimbledon Common in a 1968 magazine

photos.c: "I DON'T WANT TO BE A BIG STAR, but I do want to be a bloody good actor. That's why I'm behaving like a lunatic." Hence this picture. Cantering in the background is Michael Crawford (soon to be seen with Barbra Streisand in the Hollywood version of "Hello Dolly") who has just been signed to appear in Michael Winner's next film, "The Games," based on the novel by Hugh Atkinson and researcher Phillip Knightley. "The Games" recounts the trials of four Olympic marathon runners and to ensure the authenticity of the athletics in his film, Winner has hired Gordon Pirie as his technical adviser. It is Pirie (see above) who leads Crawford on training sessions across Wimbledon Common. "My training might not make much difference to audience reaction," says Crawford, "but the extra muscle will make me feel it's right." Next part: "The Loneliness of the Long Distance Runner"
